gizmo.title: Chaatị mmanya
gizmo.description: Na-emepụta chaatị dị mfe iru dabere na CSV.

configure.title: Aha chaatị
configure.description: Ederede alt dị mfe iru maka chaatị gị.

configure.title: Aha ọ̀tụ̀tụ̀
configure.description: Oke obosara:ogologo nke chaatị (Lee https://gionkunz.github.io/chartist-js/getting-started.html#default-sass-settings maka $ct-scales na $ct-scales-names).

configure.title: Mmanya n'ahịrị ụkwụ
configure.description: Na-atụgharị axis nke chaatị mmanya iji see chaatị mmanya n'ahịrị ụkwụ. Mara na ị ga-atụgharịkwa ntọala axis gị n'ihi na Axis Y ga-egosi akara ugbu a, Axis X ga-egosi uru.

configure.title: Kpakọba mmanya
configure.description: Ọ bụrụ na etọọ ya na true, njirimara a ga-eme ka mmanya series kpakọba.

configure.title: Kesaa series
configure.description: Ọ bụrụ na etọọ ya na true, mmanya ọ bụla ga-anọchite otu series, a na-atụkwa anya ka ndepụta data bụrụ ndepụta otu akụkụ nke uru data kama ndepụta series.

advanced.title: Tụgharịa data
advanced.description: Tụgharịa data gụnyere akara, usoro series yana ndepụta data series niile.

advanced.title: Tebụl HTML
advanced.description: Nhọrọ: Budata data dị ka tebụl HTML.

advanced.title: Ọnọdụ nkpakọba
advanced.description: Ọ bụrụ na etọọ ya na "true" njirimara a ga-emepụta mkpokọta maka isi series ọ bụla. Nke a ga-emetụtakwa y-axis na oke chaatị niile. Ọ bụrụ na etọọ ya na "false" njirimara a ga-amanye mmanya akpakọbara ka ha see site n'ahịrị efu. N'ọnọdụ nkpakọba, njirimara "seriesBarDistance" agaghị enwe mmetụta.
